synth.notes:
Player 5x5 moves 5 cells per arrow. A move is blocked if the dest box is off-board or holds any colour 4/5 cell; blocked moves still cost 2 bar cells.
Conveyor: a 5-cell colour-1 strip just outside an edge of the dest box slides the player away from it until blocked.
step_bar: each arrow turns the 2 leftmost colour-11 cells to 3. Covering a refuel ring refills the track.
Covering a 'collect' object rotates the HUD glyph (3x3 grid of 2x2 cells) 90 deg CW. The object comes back when uncovered, using memory gated on exact frame equality.
Not confirmed (never observed): chamber rejects the player while glyph != legend; the recolor token sets the glyph colour to 9.
